text: PSTCollectionView is a 100 percent API-compatible UICollectionView replacement for iOS 4.3 and later, retained for historical projects.
Aspects adds code around Objective-C methods using message forwarding, and its author warns against production use because of known runtime issues.
VibeTunnel was created collaboratively by Mario Zechner, Armin Ronacher, Peter Steinberger and other contributors, with an early working session of about 24 hours.
Peekaboo provides high-fidelity screen capture, AI analysis and complete macOS GUI automation through both a native CLI and an MCP server.
gogcli provides one binary with task-first commands, stable JSON output and explicit read-only, no-send, no-input and dry-run safety boundaries.
MCPorter is a TypeScript runtime, CLI and code-generation toolkit with typed clients, CLI generation, record and replay fixtures and atomic writes for parallel agents.
Peter states that he uses TypeScript for web work, Go for CLIs and Swift for macOS or UI work, and recommends starting products with a model and CLI so agents can call and verify output.
The OpenClaw contributors endpoint lists steipete first with 34307 contributions as of 2026-07-14.
OpenClaw started as a personal playground for a useful computer-running assistant, and its vision says core should stay lean while optional capabilities ship as plugins.
Agent Scripts is the canonical place for shared AGENTS instructions, workflow skills, portable helpers and local guardrails.
